title: Known-object test, TOI-2613.01
summary: Known-object test on TOI-2613.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. Runner: Calibration on each light curve (sign-flip null, injection–recovery): k* 3, 3, 3, ≤2.5; at the declared k = 5 the screen recovers ≥90% of 4-h dips only from depth none on grid, none on grid, none on grid, none on grid (completeness for 2000 ppm: 0%, 10%, 0%, 0%). The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Positive control: catalogued transit recovered (1 covered epoch). Residual screen: 374 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 4 light curve(s), forming 52 distinct event(s), 46 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines. Repeat candidate: a persistent event matching the catalogued depth at BJD 2460170.2953 (ΔT 15.03 d); 0 period aliases remain. Unverified lead until vetted.
